_comment: OPTIONAL local override (git-ignored). Copy to gs-admin-explorer.config.json and fill in only the fields you need.
_privateInstancePatterns: Extra case-insensitive regexes for build/check-instance-data.mjs: org-specific strings (your real tenant slugs, your org name, your consumer workspace's KB folder names) that must never appear in this repo. They live only in this git-ignored config so the detection patterns themselves never enter git history. CI gets the same list from the repository secret PRIVATE_INSTANCE_PATTERNS (one regex per line) through the environment; a fork's pull request gets no secrets and runs the generic built-in patterns only.
